verdicts.reason: Both are unusable: the forest image is shrunk into a band in the middle of a mostly empty white canvas. The headline's first word 'Special' is cut off at the top of the image, and the 'March 21' label in cream on white is almost invisible. The subline, quote and URL are lost in A. B is marginally worse because 'Joint celebration' shows up sliced off at the bottom edge of the image, which adds a visibly clipped line on top of the same failures.
